ratings_why.fun: Hand space is a real dial: Nan's copies clog the hand, which keeps goods in the Hold for Clerk, Hauler and Nyx, so the otter and heron halves pull against each other every turn.
ratings_why.distinct: Buying late at a discount, a hidden bench and a back-channel shop slot play unlike any of today's tribes; only the delay itself echoes Birds.

verdict_why: One real clarity fix (Pebble Jack stacking, which Nan makes likely); the rest is ideas.

points.text: Pebble Jack doesn't say what two copies do (twice, three times, four?). Nan copying a Run-in Jack makes two Jacks common, so it needs a line, e.g. "Doesn't stack with other Pebble Jacks."
Old Jasmine could also count units sitting in your Hold, so the hidden-fleet line and the night-run line share a capstone instead of only the arrivals line.
Officer Nyx is the tribe's one fight trick; letting her fielded units keep a small permanent buff if they survive would tie Clerk's stamps to the fight and give the thin fight identity a payoff.

Pipe Stoker turns Nan's spare copies and Squacco's Seizes into fuel, a lovely off-purpose use; a line in the builds showing Nan + Pebble Jack + Stoker (two copies per arrival, sold for stats) would help players find it.

standouts.why: Nan feeds triples, Pipe Stoker and her own hand-clog; every arrival line gets better with her, and she competes with the Hold for hand room.
Officer Nyx makes the Hold a secret bench the opponent can't scout, and rewards keeping the hand full on purpose.
Reed-island Fence turns other tribes' Discovers, triples and Fly South into arrivals, the best cross-tribe hook in the set.

weakest.why: Mudslide Pup does one obvious job; fine as the early patch but no combo hook beyond Pebble Jack.
Kettle Sinker is a flat 1-gold-a-turn trade with no tie to the Hold or Ashore after the v2 change.
Reedwhistle is a plain arrival buffer that overlaps Tibby Slick and Lantern Skipper.

flags.note: Stacking of multiple Pebble Jacks isn't stated.
The Hold has no size cap; a full hand plus Grisel and Tide-waiter Seizing grows Creel Hauler without limit, though only in the fight and linearly.
Nan with Pebble Jack makes two copies per arrival; with Pipe Stoker that is up to four sells a turn of +1/+1 to all Reed Runners. The hand cap bounds it.
Grisel with Lantern Reach Lookout Seizes a free Back Channel Tier 6 unit each quiet turn, already noted in risks.
